citation: Dai Y, et al. Sci Rep 2024;14:28550
protocol: 21-day water-only complete fast, then refeeding; capillary glucose and ketones every morning, venous blood at about 07:00 on days BF, CF5, CF10, CF15, CF21, CR4, FR5
population: 13 volunteers (8 M, 5 F), 40.5 +/- 9.7 y, BMI 24.5 +/- 3.1, no ongoing medical treatment
note: Very long fast; glucose and ketone means are given for day ranges in the text (daily curves are in a figure); strip-meter capillary values.
